name: My Big Fat Desi Wedding
overview:
Ladies and gentlemen, step inside Scotland’s most spectacular weddings, Where guest lists of 500 are ten a penny and money is no object.

In this series we go behind the scenes with the people who create these lavish events as a new generation say I do.

We’ll be there on the biggest and most emotional day of their lives, from crystal encrusted candelabras...  to Bollywood staging...  dramatic draping...  and floral fountains here minimalist is seldom the brief.
